name: skillpass-care-pilot
description: SkillPass Care reference product: portable second-owner service coverage with cross-provider continuity.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev -w @skillpass-care/api" "npm run dev -w @skillpass-care/web"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @skillpass-care/shared && npm run build -w @skillpass-care/core && npm run build -w @skillpass-care/ckb-adapter && npm run build -w @skillpass-care/provider-sdk && npm run build -w @skillpass-care/config
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @skillpass-care/api && npm run build -w @skillpass-care/web
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @skillpass-care/web
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run preflight && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:apps
